distro.description: The Linux distribution name (e.g., ubuntu, debian, rocky). Used to tailor cloud-init behavior.

search_domain.description: List of DNS search domains to append to /etc/resolv.conf. Empty means no domains added.

search_dns.description: Whether to add DNS servers to /etc/resolv.conf when using search domains.

network_renderer.description: Network backend renderer for netplan-style configs (e.g., netplan, networkd, ifupdown).

items.description: A network interface definition for netplan-like YAML

fields.description: Interface type. Only 'ethernet' is auto-rendered in this template.

network_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces. Each defines an interface block in the network config.

default_user.name.description: Username for the system's default admin user.

default_user.sudo.description: Sudo rule for the default user. Set to empty string to disable sudo.

ssh_authorized_keys.description: List of SSH public keys to install for the default user.

package_update.description: Run 'apt-get update' on first boot (or equivalent for other distros).

package_upgrade.description: Run 'apt-get upgrade' on first boot (or equivalent). Use with caution in production.

package_reboot_if_required.description: Reboot automatically if a package upgrade requires it (e.g., kernel updates).

boot_commands.description: List of shell commands to run during early boot (bootcmd), before networking is fully up.

runcmd.description: List of shell commands to run once, after the system is fully initialized.

final_message.default: The system is finally up, after $uptime seconds
final_message.description: Message printed at the end of cloud-init processing. Supports $uptime variable.

preserve_hostname.description: If true, do not change the hostname set by metadata (e.g., EC2/CloudStack).

timezone.description: System timezone, as recognized by tzdata (e.g., America/New_York).

datasource_list.description: Ordered list of datasource backends to probe. First success stops probing.

cloud_init_modules.description: List of early cloud-init modules (modules that run before full system config). Add custom modules if installed.

cloud_config_modules.description: List of core cloud-config modules (run after bootcmd). Add custom modules as needed.

cloud_final_modules.description: List of final modules (cleanup, hooks, last-run actions).
